ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB \perp BC$, $EC \perp BC$, point $D$ is on $BC$, $AB=1$, $BD=2$, $CD=3$, $CE=6$. $\triangle ABD \sim \triangle DCE$; what is the measure of $\angle ADE$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: From (1), we know that $\triangle ABD\sim \triangle DCE$, thus $\angle BAD=\angle EDC$.\\
Since $\angle BAD+\angle ADB=90^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle ADB+\angle EDC=90^\circ$.\\
Hence, $\angle ADE=180^\circ-\angle ADB-\angle EDC=90^\circ$.\\
Therefore, the measure of $\angle ADE$ is $\boxed{90^\circ}$.
